notes: In the production phase a player keeps leftover energy instead of converting it to heat.

lines.say: I get twenty two megacredits from TR plus production
I have four energy left over I'll just keep it for next generation

expect.fact: At the start of production, all leftover energy converts to heat; then each player produces megacredits (TR plus production), steel, titanium, plants, energy and heat.

lines.say: first player marker goes to Ben
